title: Orbit-to-phone feature journey
summary: A dark statement opens into a glowing selector, expanding rings cycle three benefit words, then a framed phone carries the viewer through a feed, chart and configurable list before a quiet logo hold.
use_when: a 20-30 s launch film with three connected mobile features
a dark product reveal that needs a visual bridge from promise to UI
a phone-first release with a proof chart and configurable list
a silent autoplay film where motion must explain the sequence

look.type_style: regular grotesk, sentence case, neutral tracking, benefit words 12-14 % of frame height, UI labels 2-4 %

sfx.event: opening statement reveals through the centre
phone enters and camera changes tier

structure.shot: one centred 5-word rebuild statement writes on, holds, then is erased from both sides
structure.motion: characters reveal over about 30 fr and crop away over about 23 fr, easings.outExpo (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: a dark three-option selector with circular icons, one progress rim and a short state label
structure.camera: dolly down about 400 px/s @1920 for 30 fr, then drift right about 51 px/s
structure.motion: panel enters on easings.outExpo 18 fr; progress arc advances on easings.linear for about 68 fr

structure.shot: one large benefit word sits inside a dashed ring while wider rings travel behind it
structure.motion: ring field crosses on easings.linear 83 fr; word brightens on easings.outQuint about 15 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: the central benefit changes to a second word as three outlined circles overlap
structure.camera: locked framing; rings translate left about 0.9 frame widths over 37 fr
structure.motion: word-swap on springs.ui about 15 fr; circles continue on easings.linear 37 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: a third one-word benefit resolves on black before the phone rises into frame
structure.camera: locked framing, then phone pushes upward about 0.45 frame heights in 23 fr
structure.motion: word-swap on springs.ui about 12 fr; phone enters on springs.heavy about 18 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: a generic phone shows a media-rich social feed while the content scrolls upward
structure.camera: dolly down the screen about 107 px/s @1920 for 75 fr
structure.motion: feed scrolls on easings.linear 75 fr inside a fixed device frame

structure.shot: the camera moves from the full phone to successive feed details and a compact data card
structure.camera: zoom-tier full to region to element, peak growth about 58 %/s, springs.cameraIn over about 36 fr
structure.motion: screen content keeps scrolling on easings.linear while tier changes settle on springs.cameraIn (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: a compact market-style card fills the phone, with one value, positive delta and rising line chart
structure.camera: dolly down about 255 px/s @1920 while holding the chart near centre
structure.motion: line chart draws left to right on easings.outQuint about 23 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: a phone settings screen presents three topic rows; each row lifts forward, then settles into a pinned group
structure.camera: zoom-tier region to detail, scale about 1.00 to 1.25 over 97 fr on springs.cameraIn
structure.motion: three rows list-assemble with 8 fr stagger and springs.layout about 18 fr each (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: the feed returns with the new topic tabs visible, then the phone recedes toward black
structure.camera: zoom-tier region to detail on springs.cameraIn 24 fr, then pull-out on springs.cameraOut about 18 fr (±0.25 s)
structure.motion: feed settles on springs.ui about 18 fr; device exits downward on easings.inExpo about 18 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: a small centred 3-word production line appears on black, holds briefly, then wipes away
structure.camera: locked centre framing with no camera move for 60 fr
structure.motion: quiet-close fades in on easings.outQuint about 15 fr and mask-wipes out over about 23 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: a geometric white mark appears at centre and holds on pure black
structure.camera: locked centre framing with no camera move for 93 fr
structure.motion: mark fades in on easings.outQuint about 8 fr, then holds for about 85 fr (±0.25 s)

params.brand: any brand.json; colours, fonts, radius and final mark skin every scene
params.content.benefits: three single-word outcomes for the ring sequence
params.content.feedItems: 4-6 generic feed cards with original user-supplied copy
params.content.chart: one label, value, delta and 7-10 points for the proof card
params.content.topics: three configurable list rows with neutral icons
params.content.closingLine: one short production or availability line
params.aspect: 16:9 master; device and type scale from the composition size
params.fps: composition fps; all reference timings are measured at 30 fps

notes: No detected cuts and no audio. All state boundaries come from 4 fps sheets at ±0.25 s. Ring geometry is recorded as the proposed term ring-field, not as a vocabulary id. The final mark entrance is also below temporal resolution. SFX are planned by the glue rule, not measured. Palette sampled from full-resolution keyframes because no cut frames exist. Three UI states require a React rebuild; supplied media must be original or licensed.
